description: NaCaAlPHO₅F₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one O and four equivalent F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.41 Å. There are two shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.49 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Ca is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form CaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are two shorter (2.36 Å) and two longer (2.40 Å) Ca-O bond lengths. Both Ca-F bond lengths are 2.31 Å. Al is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form AlO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-56°. There are two shorter (1.88 Å) and two longer (1.93 Å) Al-O bond lengths. Both Al-F bond lengths are 1.87 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with four equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-62°. There are three shorter (1.55 Å) and one longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond length. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Al and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ca and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Ca and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Al, and one H atom. F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂CaAl tetrahedra.
